jailor.summary: Truthful Jailor or alignment-only TPow is the default. A temporary cover can conceal your exact power, but may mislead Town protection and votes. Keep your real history privately and abandon the cover when coordination, a counterclaim, or your public ability matters. These are situational editorial options, not measured win-rate rankings.

options.why: Both can keep ordinary visiting claims out of their public story; jail still leaves a prisoner who can describe what happened.
options.bestWhen: Your exact Jailor identity is still hidden, no one needs it to coordinate, and the cover matches your actual movement so far.
options.exposure: A prisoner can identify a real Jailor interaction. Visitor reports or an alert claim can contradict your cover.
strategy: Do not invent alerts, visitor kills, or a Veteran confirmation. Reveal enough of your real jail history to resolve a counterclaim.
Prefer an alignment-only TPow claim when that gives enough information without an exact-role cover.
Keep the real Jailor actions and any cover history separate; a sample will does not give you another role’s ability.
Return to your real role before a contradiction misdirects Town votes or protection; explain the reason for the temporary cover.
